data.name: Barkyard Blitz
data.detailed_description:
🐶 FREE DEMO - SEPTEMBER 11

Get ready to herd, steal, and bark your way to the top!

Play Barkyard Blitz for free on September 11 and experience chaotic sheep herding, bark-powered combat, temporary abilities, and unpredictable farm events.


About the Game

EVERY BARK IS A WEAPON. EVERY SHEEP IS A SCORE.

HERD. STEAL. BARK. REPEAT.

What if your only weapon was a bark?

Barkyard Blitz is a chaotic third-person multiplayer game where dogs herd sheep, steal rival flocks, blast opponents across the farm, and fight to stay on top.

Claim loose sheep and guide them through your color-coded gate to score. But scored sheep stay in the arena, making every point a target.

Rivals can blast your flock away, steal your sheep, and turn a comfortable lead into a desperate comeback.

One moment you're winning.

The next, you're chasing your own sheep across the farm.

🐶 THIS IS NOT YOUR AVERAGE SHEEP GAME.

Your points have legs. Your weapon is a bark. And the farm is actively trying to ruin your day.

🐑 YOUR POINTS HAVE LEGS

Herd sheep to score, but don't get comfortable. Rival players can steal your scored flock and turn your lead against you.

💨 YOUR BARK IS YOUR WEAPON

Blast sheep, knock rivals away, interrupt attacks, and create chaotic chain reactions.

🌪️ THE FARM FIGHTS BACK

Horse stampedes, prize cows, wolf raids, and future events can turn your perfect strategy upside down.

🦴 GAIN ABILITIES ON THE FLY

Find bones during a match and gain temporary abilities that can completely change the way you play.

🏠 BUILD, TRAP, AND DEFEND

Future updates will let you build defenses and set traps around your base to protect your flock from enemy raids.

🐶 PLAY YOUR WAY

Choose different dog breeds and unique abilities to create your own playstyle.

🐑🐺 MORE THAN JUST DOGS

Future updates will introduce new playable roles, including Sheep and Wolf, giving players completely different ways to experience the farm.

💨 YOUR BARK IS YOUR WEAPON

Forget guns.

You have a bark.

Charge it up and unleash a powerful blast of wind that can send sheep, dogs, and hay bales flying.

Tap for a quick, wide burst or hold to charge a narrower, longer-reaching blast.

Use your bark to:

• Scatter rival flocks

• Knock competing dogs off course

• Interrupt enemy attacks

• Launch hay bales into chain reactions

• Defend your flock

• Create the perfect opening for a steal

Every bark is a decision.

Attack. Defend. Steal.

🐕 CHOOSE YOUR DOG. PLAY YOUR WAY.

Not every dog plays the same way.

Choose a dog with its own unique ability and build your playstyle around it.

Run faster to outrun rivals and escape with a flock.

Double jump to dodge attacks and reach places other dogs can't.

Unleash a stronger bark to send sheep and opponents flying.

More dog breeds and unique abilities are planned as Barkyard Blitz grows.

Which dog will you become?

🦴 GRAB BONES. GAIN POWER.

Bones can appear around the farm during a match.

Grab one to gain a temporary ability and adapt your strategy on the fly.

Need to catch a fleeing flock?

Power up your speed.

Want to send a rival flying?

Strengthen your bark.

The right bone at the right moment can change the entire match.

🌪️ THE FARM NEVER STAYS QUIET

Unexpected events can turn a match upside down.

🐴 HORSE STAMPEDE

A horse charges through the arena, scattering anything in its path.

🐄 PRIZE COW

A high-value cow appears. Claim it before your rivals and grab a huge point boost.

🐺 WOLF RAID

Wolves attack a player's base, scattering their flock and putting their score at risk.

And the farm is only getting wilder.

Future events are planned, including storms, sudden flock surges, new animal events, and other unpredictable surprises.

You never know what the farm will throw at you next.

🐑 YOUR SCORE CAN BE STOLEN

In Barkyard Blitz, scoring doesn't make your sheep disappear.

Your flock stays in the arena, making every point a target.

Build your herd.

Protect your farm.

Raid the leader.

And when someone scatters your flock across the map...

GO GET THEM BACK.

A comfortable lead can disappear in seconds.

🏆 8 MINUTES. ONE WINNER.

Every match is an intense 8-minute battle.

Herd sheep. Score points. Raid rivals. Defend your flock.

When the final seconds arrive, every sheep can make the difference.

No lead is safe until the clock hits zero.

🐶 PLAY SOLO OR BRING THE PACK

Want to practice your barking before jumping online?

Enter Rival Arena and compete against AI-controlled dogs.

Experiment with different abilities, learn the farm, and master the art of herding and stealing.

Then take the fight online and battle against up to 10 players.

🆕 THE FARM IS JUST GETTING STARTED

Barkyard Blitz is built to grow.

Future updates are planned to introduce new ways to play, new ways to customize your dog, and even more chaos across the farm.

🐕 MORE DOGS. MORE ABILITIES.

Discover new dog breeds with unique abilities and playstyles.

⬆️ IN-MATCH UPGRADES

Gain new abilities during a match and experiment with different combinations.

🏠 BUILD. TRAP. DEFEND.

Build defensive structures, place traps, and protect your flock from enemy raids.

🌪️ MORE FARM CHAOS

Expect storms, dynamic weather, sudden flock surges, new animals, environmental hazards, and more unpredictable events.

🐑 PLAY AS THE SHEEP

Don't herd them.

Become them.

Escape the dogs and find new ways to survive on the farm.

🐺 PLAY AS THE WOLF

Stop chasing sheep.

Hunt them.

Disrupt herds and turn the farm against the dogs.

🎰 FIND THE SECRET SLOT MACHINE

Somewhere on the farm, a secret slot machine is waiting to be discovered.

Find it, spin it, and win exclusive cosmetic customizations for your dogs.

The farm has secrets.

You just have to find them.

🗺️ MORE MAPS. MORE ANIMALS. MORE CHAOS.

New maps, animals, events, abilities, dog breeds, and customization options are planned for future updates.

The dogs are only the beginning.

🆓 FREE DEMO COMING SEPTEMBER 11

The first Barkyard Blitz demo arrives September 11.

Choose your dog, charge your bark, grab bones, herd sheep, steal rival flocks, survive farm events, and fight your way to the top.

Play solo against AI or bring the chaos online.

The full game is targeting Q4 2026, with online matches supporting up to 10 players.

WISHLIST NOW AND BE READY TO BARK ON SEPTEMBER 11.

🐶 HERD. RAID. RECOVER.

Claim the flock.

Defend the farm.

Bark your way to victory.

data.short_description: Herd sheep, steal points, and blast your rivals with weaponized barking! Gain unique abilities, defend your base, survive chaotic events, and play different roles in the ultimate farmyard battle.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2 or Direct3D 12-capable GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Keyboard and mouse required. Broadband Internet connection required for online play. Provisional until release-candidate QA.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 15.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or 64-bit Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 3-compatible graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal Apple Silicon/Intel build. Keyboard and mouse required. Broadband Internet connection required for online play. Provisional until release-candidate QA.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or equivalent 64-bit distribution with glibc 2.38 or later
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core x86_64 processor with SSE4.2 support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2-capable GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Native x86_64 target. Keyboard and mouse required. Broadband Internet connection required for online play. Preliminary—Linux build and compatibility testing are not complete.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
